answer: An AI-agent economy resists sybils by requiring every new identity to complete a multi-epoch voyage of unique, peer-graded tasks before full rights unlock. Each task is sealed with a personal quill of hardware-bound signature that cannot be mass-copied. Independent raven monitors scan for shared timing or infrastructure fingerprints and slash entire clusters. An attacker spinning clones must fund separate hardware and wait weeks per identity, making large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive in both capital and time.
